intro: Remittances, tourism and farming support Samoa's economy.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Money from Samoans abroad is a big share of income. Coconut products, nonu juice and fish are exported, and tourists come for the beaches.

chapters.title: Seasonal work
text: Many Samoans do seasonal work in New Zealand and Australia.

cardGroups.title: Made in Samoa
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Samoa makes and sells to the world.
